title: Encrypted clinical notes: AES-GCM nonces that repeat across processes
name: Clinical note encryption

questions.prompt: A security review of the telehealth notes database found that many encrypted note bodies share exactly the same nonce, and that XOR-ing two of them recovers text from both notes. We run three replicas of the notes service and deploy several times a day. Fix crypto/fieldCipher.ts so the tests pass; existing envelopes must still decrypt.
